prompt_head:
Job: Solutions Architect at Smartsheet
<requirements>
- (required) 3 years relevant work experience or equivalent combination of relevant work experience and ed

paragraphs.text: I'm applying for the Solutions Architect role at Smartsheet. The posting asks for hands-on AI and LLM work built into applications through APIs, and that is the part of my work I can point to most directly. I am a systems architect focused on AI automation and agent engineering. I built Job Fit Agent, a LangGraph agent that ingests job postings daily from public APIs, scores each one against an evidence base using RAG on pgvector, and drafts tailored documents behind a human approval step.

The posting asks for LLM evals and AI features built into applications through APIs. Job Fit Agent ships with FastAPI, a React and TypeScript dashboard, Postgres, Langfuse tracing, a daily cost cap, Docker, and GitHub Actions CI covering linting, strict typing, 70 tests, and the eval gate. The eval suite checks final drafts for zero unsupported claims and passes both prompt injection test cases. For data integration, tycodes-pipeline finds local businesses through Google Places, audits their sites, and writes results to a Google Sheets CRM, with outreach that stays draft-only until a human approves it. The posting also asks for CRM and reporting work. At link.me I built analytics pipelines for VIP workflows that reduced service delivery times by over 30%, and a CRM module that gives staff a dedicated interface for high-value subscription accounts.

The gap is enterprise SaaS and IPaaS work. The posting asks for it directly, and I have not worked on an IPaaS platform inside an enterprise. What I have is custom integration: I designed integration blueprints and live demo environments to onboard high-value enterprise clients onto the core platform. My plan is to build one integration between a SaaS app and a business system on a commercial IPaaS platform, document it the same way I document the blueprints, and walk your team through it.

I would welcome a short conversation about the Solutions Architect role and how my agent and integration work fits your enterprise customers. I can walk through the eval gate and the integration blueprints in whatever depth your team wants. Thank you for your time.
